pedestrian.cause_evidence: Old RGB candidate repeatedly overwrote odometry-updated remaining distance. Later tracked distance stayed about10.5cm ahead of actual distance; not a55cm jump to the next stripe.

bottom_corner.cause_evidence: Late turn command, then avoidance chose milder steering. After lane loss, avoidance briefly chose straight steering; lost-lane timeout stopped the vehicle. Raw lidar points were not recorded, so exact blocked point is unproven.
bottom_corner.telemetry_caution: control.speed is last computed driver value and can remain stale during sensor-wait. Actual sent command must be read from trajectory.csv.

scope: No control, teleport or ground-truth feedback. Source timestamps are preserved; trajectory interpolation is for this audit only.
